name: Helmut von Giuseppe
original_name: ヘルムート・フォン・ジュゼッペ
source:
A former neurologist for the [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stasi]Stasi[/url], he excels at brainwashing and manipulation. A collector of antique guns and weaponry, he is responsible for both Ein and Zwei's amnesia.

Weapon of choice: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luger_pistol]Luger P08[/url] (Semi Automatic Pistol).
